prompts.shard: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D mobile fantasy game projectile animation sprite sheet for Mochi Mayhem, Mint Crystal Impaler homing ice shard. Create ONE square 1024x1024 RGBA sheet, exactly 2 columns x 2 rows, four equal 512x512 cells, read left to right then next row. Each cell contains the SAME small sleek faceted mint-cyan ice crystal arrowhead pointing exactly RIGHT, compact diamond spear tip at x65% of the cell with a flowing icy ribbon/wind tail extending left toward x20%, narrow horizontal silhouette occupying 72% cell width and 30% height, consistently centered at (50%,50%). Four subtle looping animation phases: shimmer and ribbon flutter, unchanged silhouette size, position and direction. Cute hand-painted confectionery magic, cool turquoise shadow outlines, luminous pale blue facets, tiny white highlights and two small star glints, soft 2-3-tone shading, crisp silhouette readable at 30px. Attractive polished game art, no photorealism, no harsh black outlines. Truly TRANSPARENT empty background including between sprites, no opaque panel, no checkerboard, no text or labels, no borders/grid lines, no extra objects. Keep all pixels at least 48px from each cell border. Four phases should loop smoothly with the last visually leading back into the first. Deliver the sheet only.
prompts.storm: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless-loop snowstorm magic VFX sprite sheet for a cute hand-painted 2D mobile fantasy game. Make ONE 1536x1024 transparent RGBA atlas, EXACTLY 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows, eight equal rectangular cells, read left to right across the first row then second. Within EACH cell, render the same contained circular blizzard viewed 3/4 top-down: a low horizontal oval ring of icy mint wind at ground level, lots of distinct falling slanted white snow streaks and small faceted ice diamonds descending from an airy swirl above, softly curling snow around the outer edges. The effect is a STATIONARY magical area, not a tornado, not an explosion, no solid central cone. Show volume as a short dome of snowfall above a flattened ground oval; the central 45% is mostly clear TRANSPARENT space so monsters remain readable. Eight successive animation phases at equal intensity, wind/snow travel clockwise and downwards, first and last lead smoothly into each other. Same exact center, footprint and scale in all cells. Cool mint, pale cyan, periwinkle shadows, white icy highlights; elegant softly outlined storybook game painting, readable large flakes, no photographic snow fog. Each entire effect fits inside its own cell with 10% clear margin and cannot cross into neighbors. The empty background and center are genuine transparent alpha, no black/white/gray rectangle, no checkerboard texture, no landscape, no character, no text, no grid lines, no labels or watermark. Consistent polished animation kit, no increasing burst intensity. Sheet only.
